post: Week 1 · Sun · ABC Q&A: fit, schedule and payment
caption:
Thinking about joining AI Builder's Camp? Here are the questions we get most 👇

🧩 Do I need to be techy? You'll set up Claude and ChatGPT with step-by-step guides, and your coaches guide you every week.
🗓️ How much time does it take? A Saturday main session, a Tuesday hands-on lab, small-group coaching, a Thursday podcast and one weekly task.
▶️ What if I miss a session? Replays are posted in the community.
🎁 What will I have after 8 weeks? Your personal purpose blueprint, your own digital product, and the know-how to sell it.
💳 How much is it? Full details and pricing for Batch 3 are at aibuilderscamp.ph.

Batch 3 is coming. 👉 aibuilderscamp.ph
